title: The repo-root wrangler manifest is the sole declaration of the Worker's deploy shape
iWant: one file at the repo root that declares the Worker name, entry, compatibility settings, and every binding
soThat: the deploy shape is legible without reading CI scripts or a vendor dashboard

acceptanceCriteria.description: A `wrangler.toml` (or `wrangler.jsonc`) exists at the repo root, parses as valid config, and its top-level object carries `name`, `main`, `compatibility_date`, and every non-secret binding block the Worker's runtime code references (KV namespaces, D1 databases, R2 buckets, Durable Object namespaces, static-assets binding, and non-secret environment variables); secret bindings are implicit through env-accessor references in the Worker source and are NOT declared in the manifest (wrangler 4.x has no `[secrets]` block, no `secrets.required[]` list, and no empty-value binding entry for secrets).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh clone of a repo that has applied the blueprint and realised the manifest
acceptanceCriteria.when: a manifest loader parses the file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the loader returns a config object whose `name` is a non-empty string, `main` resolves to an existing entry file, `compatibility_date` matches `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}`, and every non-secret binding name referenced from the Worker's source appears as a declaration key in the config; the config carries no `[secrets]` block

acceptanceCriteria.description: A CI gate scans the Worker's source tree for references to bindings (env accessors keyed by binding name) and refuses the build when a referenced binding name has no matching declaration in `wrangler.toml`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a change adds `env.NEW_KV.get(...)` to the Worker source and does not add `NEW_KV` to `wrangler.toml`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the CI gate runs on the change
acceptanceCriteria.then: the run fails with a stable-coded `WRANGLER_BINDING_UNDECLARED` error naming the offending source path and the missing binding name

acceptanceCriteria.description: The manifest never carries a secret VALUE; a source-tree scan across every file that could contribute a bound value at deploy time (the wrangler config, any `.env`-shaped file the deploy step reads, any CI environment block committed to the repo) finds no match for any value the secrets contract resolves.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the secrets contract resolves a set of secret values `V` for the current environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: a redaction-scanner runs against `wrangler.toml`, any committed environment file, and the CI workflows
acceptanceCriteria.then: no file in the scanned set contains any byte sequence in `V`

acceptanceCriteria.description: The wrangler manifest [assets] block, when the elicited run-worker-first answer is true, carries the boolean literal run_worker_first = true (and only that literal). Every application shipped under this shape asserts that an unauthenticated request to any protected route (for example /notes) reaches the Worker fetch handler before the static-asset pipeline runs, and the Worker's auth middleware gates it. The array-of-patterns form on the same field is a vendor-supported alternative recorded on TAC-1302 but not the shape this AC binds.
acceptanceCriteria.given: wrangler manifest [assets].directory non-empty and run_worker_first = true
acceptanceCriteria.when: an unauthenticated request lands on a Worker route the auth middleware protects
acceptanceCriteria.then: the fetch handler runs before the static-asset pipeline, the auth middleware refuses, and no static asset is served
